note: d_min=0.07 — no effect because b=0.001 (exponential fit), decline rate 0.196 never reaches d_min floor. d_min changes are irrelevant for this well until b is increased.
significance_threshold=0.35 — detected 2013 workover as phase break, fit_months dropped from 134 to 106 (fitting later phase independently). Massive improvement.
significance_threshold=0.30 — further phase isolation, fit_months 106->95, qi=692, di=0.389. R2 outsample improved to -0.11.
outlier_threshold=0.20 — no effect, rejection rate unchanged at 5%. The anomalous months are already handled by phase detection.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — no effect, optimizer converges to same qi=692 regardless of starting guess.
smoothing_window=5 — slightly worse, wider smoothing blurs phase boundaries. fit_months 95->94.
di_initial=0.80 — no effect, optimizer converges to same di=0.389 regardless of starting point.
peak_merge_distance=5 — much worse, merging combined phases back to 110 fit_months. The separate phase detection at distance=3 is critical.
